title: 第1726章有人欢喜有人愁万众瞩目第1725章六科放榜天下同庆
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 无数学子下意识的往前挤。
张平冷冷扫了一眼，开口道。
张寿亲手揭开第一幅红榜。
礼部官吏立刻高声唱名。
一行行的名字出现在众人眼前，开始张贴榜单。
张寿没有停顿，一个个名字从他的口中迸出，他最后直接念到最上方，一双目光径直落在人群中正像一只鬣狗一般疯狂撕咬大饼的陈稻生。
“这个名字没听过啊，明农魁首竟不是世家？”
陈稻生正吃着大饼，整个人都僵住了。
他听到最后，本来都觉得自己肯定没戏了，准备打道回府了。
没想到，他竟拿到了第一！
陈稻生一脸茫然的指了指自己。
旁边一个农家子弟猛地推了陈稻生一把。
陈稻生手一抖，手里的大饼差点掉在了地上。
他赶忙攥紧大饼，眼眶却一下红了。
几个工部老农官挤过来看他。
其中一个看着他满手的老茧，忽然笑了。
陈稻生嘴唇动了动，半天没说出话，只是把手中的大饼攥得更紧。
这个死死攥着大饼的穷小子，从今日起，不一样了。
content_en:
Boom!
As soon as these words came out.
The atmosphere outside the Gongyuan was filled with excitement.
Countless students squeezed forward subconsciously.
Zhang Ping glanced coldly and said.
"Those who collide with the standing platform will receive twenty sticks."
Everyone became honest again instantly.
Zhang Shou personally unveiled the first red list.
The officials of the Ministry of Rites immediately called out the names loudly.
"Ming Nong Ke!"
A red list show.
Lines of names appeared in front of everyone, and lists began to be posted.
Zhang Shou did not pause, one name after another burst out of his mouth, and finally he read directly to the top, his eyes fell directly on Chen Daosheng in the crowd who was frantically biting the pie like a hyena.
"Leader Minnong."
"Chen Daosheng!"
Boom!
There was a sudden commotion in the crowd.
"Chen Daosheng?"
"Who is Chen Daosheng?"
"I've never heard of this name. Leader Minnong is not from a noble family?"
corner.
Chen Daosheng was eating the big cake, and his whole body froze.
When he heard the end, he thought he was definitely out of luck and was ready to go home.
Unexpectedly, he actually got the first place!
"Me?"
Chen Daosheng pointed at himself with a confused look.
A farmer's boy next to him gave Chen Daosheng a shove.
"Brother Chen, it's you!"
"You're hit!"
"You are the number one in Minnong!"
Chen Daosheng's hand shook and the big cake in his hand almost fell to the ground.
He quickly grasped the pie tightly, but his eyes turned red.
"Am I hit?"
"Mother..."
"Am I really hit?"
Several old peasant officials from the Ministry of Industry crowded over to see him.
One of them looked at the calluses on his hands and suddenly smiled.
"Okay."
"At first glance, this hand is really bad."
"Chief Minnong, you should have these hands!"
Chen Daosheng's lips moved and he didn't say anything for a long time. He just held the big cake in his hand tighter.
At that moment, everyone suddenly felt.
This poor boy who clung to the big pie was different from today on.
